skins.name: Candy Strike
skins.description: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Candy Strike. Clothes Odda changed into to fit the neighborhood event's theme. Featuring bright colors and breathable materials, suited for anyone who enjoys outdoor exercise.

skins.name: Melodic Flutter
skins.description: Clothes Ines wore when posing for a music-themed portrait. The magnificent dress is a perfect match for the music, as the butterflies dance to the melody, bringing the reverie to life in vivid detail.

skins.name: Golden Reverie
skins.description: Dress carefully picked by Muelsyse. The top is bright and brazen, like the early dawnlight, and the skirt is soft and sable, like the moons playing across a still lake—a perfect union of luxury and solemnity.

skins.name: Empty Crown
skins.description: Outfit Stainless tailored for himself. With unique armor designs and bold weapon modifications, he has successfully recreated the image of a heroic knight in his heart.

skins.name: Ethereal Harmony
skins.description: Stage clothing picked by conductor Mostima herself. A mysterious blue serves as the main hue, a blue of grace and beauty, a fitting accompaniment to the stage she built.

skins.name: Radiant Serenity
skins.description: Clothes Logos wore as a guest at the Liches ' spire. Golden moons and stars adorn a base of blue-gray fabric, graceful yet profound.
